operators.name: Ace
operators.abilityDescription: With the S.E.L.M.A. Aqua Breacher, water is the name of the game. It makes use of hydraulic pressure to burst through breakable and reinforced surfaces. The cylinder is thrown on whatever Ace is trying to breach, and then it opens to fully deploy. It explodes one time on floors, ceilings and hatches, but on walls the cylinder rolls down to deploy up to two times, if space allows. Each of these deployments leaves a clean rectangle breach, combining to create a hole big enough for an Operator to go through easily.
operators.quote: "The perfect shot, like the perfect rescue, is all about the framing."

operators.name: Alibi
operators.abilityDescription: Prisma projects holograms identical to Alibi in an idle position. If you shoot or touch the holograms, you’ll be marked and pinged for the next few seconds. If Prisma is deployed outside, a false “Defender Outside” warning is triggered for Attackers. To add an element of surprise, Prisma conceals the identity of any Defender who ventures outside. Any bullet, melee, or explosives damages Prisma, and will shoot through the hologram. Be careful not to stand too close.
operators.quote: "Never reveal the cards you were dealt."

operators.name: Amaru
operators.abilityDescription: With the Garra Hook, Amaru can grapple onto ledges and windows and hoist herself up in record times. Her opponents now not only have to worry about attacks from above, but also attacks from below. With the Garra, Amaru is the only operator that can go up an open hatch, instead of down. When timed right, hooking the Garra onto a window can result in Amaru’s infamous Garra Kick, which instantly takes out an opponent standing behind the window.
operators.quote: "Forget who you are, and nothing else matters. You'll fight for anyone, and never know why."

operators.name: Aruni
operators.abilityDescription: Once in place, the gate projects a laser array capable of detecting anyone moving through it. When an intruder is detected, energy output to the laser increases, causing second- and third-degree burns. We spent nearly an hour tossing everything from wads of paper to pieces of fruit through until we found a setting that maximizes damage while limiting energy consumption.
operators.quote: "In every conflict, it's the children who are made to suffer, even after the fighting has stopped."

operators.name: Ash
operators.abilityDescription:
Ash is a fast-paced front liner; capable of breaching, flanking and dividing the Defender's attention in seconds.

Ash is capable of ranged soft breaching thanks to her modified M120 CREM Breaching Rounds.
operators.quote: "You can never truly understand a conflict until you've been on both sides."

operators.name: Azami
operators.abilityDescription: The Kiba Barrier is a modified kunai that sticks to a surface after it's thrown and releases a material that first expands then solidifies, creating a bulletproof barrier to patch up those holes in your defenses.
operators.quote: "Honor is not the only thing worth protecting…but sometimes it's all you have left."

operators.name: Bandit
operators.abilityDescription:
Bandit is a secure, anti-hard breacher and roamer, capable of denying key entry points for the attackers and defending the objective while on the move.

Bandit is capable of electrifying a variety of surfaces thanks to his special ability: Crude Electrical Device or CED-1 Shock Wire.
operators.quote: "Survival is all about timing. Nature doesn't give second chances."

operators.name: Blackbeard
operators.abilityDescription: Blackbeard comes equipped with the H.U.L.L. Adaptable Shield. The shield is capable of adapting it's shape to grant the best cover while on foot and in rappel. The shield also includes a breaching pneumatic system that allows Blackbeard to create his own rotations by destroy soft walls. Blackbeard's weapon skills allow him to simultaneously equip the H.U.L.L. Adaptable Shield and primary weapons.
operators.quote: "I'm a diver. We're used to seeing threats through a layer of tempered glass."

operators.name: Blitz
operators.abilityDescription:
- Ballistic shield
- Three rows of eight flash-bang grenades provide a high intensity light source
operators.quote: "I don't like photos of myself. The lighting is always wrong."

operators.name: Brava
operators.abilityDescription: Brava's Kludge Drone is a sabotage tool capable of taking over opponents' devices. If the device can't be controlled, it's destroyed instead.
operators.quote: "Sometimes the only path to justice is through a bullet…"

operators.name: Buck
operators.abilityDescription:
Under-barrel mounted 12 gauge shotgun with four round capacity, used in tandem with an assault rifle.
The Skeleton Key allows the operator to alternate between their standard issue assault rifle and a breaching shotgun with ease and efficiency.
operators.quote: "Follow me. I know a shortcut."

operators.name: CAPITÃO
operators.abilityDescription: Use a glass bolt to deliver a swift and silent assault against hostiles without alerting them to your position. The glass cartridge breaks on impact releasing a gas that ignites the oxygen in the surrounding area. Deliver swift and agile assaults without alerting your opponents of your position.
operators.quote: "Focusing only on the bad things in life will keep you from seeing the many opportunities to do good."

operators.name: Castle
operators.abilityDescription:
Castle is an anchor and secure Operator, capable of creating defensive strongholds around the objective, controlling the flow of the attackers and slowing down their assault.
Castle's unique ability is to create reinforced barricades using the: UTP1-Universal Tactical Panel.
operators.quote: "Listen up, people: No one dies today. Any questions'll just have to wait."

operators.name: Caveira
operators.abilityDescription:
"The “Luison” is wrapped in a rock-based mineral fiber to both insulate and soundproof the silencer. This weapon allows Caveira to incapacitate her target discreetly and conduct an interrogation.
The “Luison” is not only formidable to neutralize your opponent while remaining undetected; it also ensures that no one gets away.
operators.quote: "Not every child gets to choose who they grow up to be."

operators.name: Clash
operators.abilityDescription: Reworked for greater mobility, Clash's CCE Shield can anchor to the ground, letting her roam free and taser the enemy remotely to slow them down while she takes them out from a distance. While carrying the CCE Shield, Clash can use the same free look ability as other Operators, and benefit from her shield expanding and collapsing depending on the situation she finds herself in.
operators.quote: "Change will come if you're willing to fight for it."

operators.name: Deimos
operators.abilityDescription: The miniature flying probe seeks out a chosen target and reveals their location to Deimos while also revealing his location. with his custom .44 Vendetta being the only weapon available while tracking, Deimos makes it personal.
operators.quote: "I was there when Rainbow began. I'll be there when it ends."

operators.name: Denari
operators.abilityDescription: Cover an entire room with Denari's unique ability, the T.R.I.P. Connector. When two devices are deployed within line of sight of each other, a laser connects between them. Once tripped, the laser will slow and injure enemies. Deploying more devices will create a larger web of lasers, creating an area of denial to best fit defensive needs for any room.
operators.quote: "Take a seat, play a round. What's the worst that can happen?"

operators.name: Doc
operators.abilityDescription:
- Handheld, trigger-operated pistol
- 1mg dose of epinephrine, in a saline solution
- The pistol is powered by a pressurized CO2 canister
operators.quote: "My job is to keep you alive. Make it as hard as you like."

operators.name: Dokkaebi
operators.abilityDescription: Coming from the Korean 제거,“elimination”, Jegeo Payloads replace Logic Bombs as the malware Dokkaebi can upload to enemy devices to block Observation Tools. Targeted phones with the payload explode, causing 40hp of damage to the carrier and creating a fire that can damage other nearby Operators. This unique ability has more charges and a faster cooldown, but a shorter duration—every activation matters more. It’s about precise and coordinated timing.
operators.quote: "You say potato, I say botnet."

operators.name: Echo
operators.abilityDescription:
Equipped with an acoustic hailing device, this signature drone can fire ultrasonic bursts that disorient all targets in a given perimeter. Yokai also transmits a video feed to Echo, who keeps his immediate perimeter secure.
Embrace the power of technology and embody a turret Defender who can both hold up the siege and support roamers.
operators.quote: "Don't ask me what I'm doing on my phone. You don't want to know."

operators.name: Ela
operators.abilityDescription:
Inspired by the 1939 anti-tank Polish grenades used by the iconic Cichociemny during WWII, the sticky Grzmot mines can be anchored on surfaces, impairing hearing and causing a dizzying effect.
These concussion mines are triggered upon proximity, affecting anyone within its radius.
operators.quote: "Together, we can shake the very stars from the sky."

operators.name: Fenrir
operators.abilityDescription: The F-NATT DREAD MINE is a throwable device that sticks to walls, so it can be hidden in places where fear can fester. Fenrir comes equipped with 5 mines and can activate 3 at a time anywhere on the map.
operators.quote: "Fear is a teacher. There's always a lesson to be learned."

operators.name: Finka
operators.abilityDescription: Finka's Adrenal Surge activates pre-injected nanobots made of zinc in operators, releasing a pharmacological cocktail into their system where the zinc is absorbed as a nutrient. These nanites give her team a short boost in HP, they help allies out of DBNO, and they steady the team’s aim. She’s the only one capable of tailoring the nanites to specific operators.
operators.quote: "The hand you get dealt isn't the one you have to keep."

operators.name: Flores
operators.abilityDescription: Controlled from a distance, the RCE-Ratero Charge races forward while Flores scouts a location for its blast. Once triggered, the Ratero clutches onto the nearest surface, armors itself with a bulletproof shell, and explodes, destroying nearby gadgets and soft surfaces.
operators.quote: "In life, you have to commit to the things that make you happy. For me, that's robbing the rich and corrupt."

operators.name: Frost
operators.abilityDescription:
The rubber mat and concealed metal jaws are bolted in place. When the pressure plate is engaged, two sets of jaws at ankle and shin height deploy, locking the person in place.
Operators who fall onto a Welcome Mat will be able to remove it from their leg by themselves or with the help of a teammate.
operators.quote: "There are two things the human body needs most in a survival situation: Water, and hope."

operators.name: Fuze
operators.abilityDescription: Fuze is best played as an aggressive flanker and area denial Operator. His strengths allow him to dispatch defensive capabilities and harass enemies anchored in defensive positions. Fuze's APM-6 cluster charge propels a group of explosive cluster grenades through any soft breach surface.
operators.quote: "Chaos is only an enemy if you're unable to adapt."

operators.name: Glaz
operators.abilityDescription:
Glaz is a back-line marksman, capable of soft breaching and providing covering fire from a distance.

Glaz is capable of ranged shooting through his unique scope ability: HDS Flipsight.
operators.quote: "Imagination keeps you alive. It's how you find your way out of the dark. That, and a flashlight."

operators.name: Goyo
operators.abilityDescription: Like the ordinary Deployable Shield, the Volcán Shield provides cover and allows Defenders to block pathways, but Goyo turns up the heat with an attached incendiary bomb. From the front, however, there’s little indication of which it might be. Until someone shoots the bomb to make it explode, the shield continues to be an obstacle for the Attackers.
operators.quote: "A person is never more honest than when they think they're alone."

operators.name: Gridlock
operators.abilityDescription: Trax Stingers' design is a portable version that when activated, deploys a hexagonal cluster of spikes, covering uneven ground better than a straight mat. Once deployed they can replicate and spread out over a large area. This feature, unique for an Attacker, enables them to use the Trax as an obstacle to reshape the map and control an area. Effects on the enemy include slowing them down and causing damage when stepped on. Trax Stingers will be destroyed when shot or dealt impact or thermal damage.
operators.quote: "You've gotta have a couple of roos loose in the top paddock to sign up for this life, but there's nowhere I'd rather be."

operators.name: Grim
operators.abilityDescription: You've heard the buzz, and the Kawan Hive Launcher is here! Firing off a projectile releases a swarm of bots that track the location of opponents who walk through it. Just don't get them in your eyes.
operators.quote: "Get out of my way."

operators.name: Hibana
operators.abilityDescription:
The X-KAIROS - a 40 mm caliber launcher - fires explosive pellets that can be detonated simultaneously from a distance.
Deliver innovative assaults by creating lines of sights, or new pathways!
operators.quote: "Kyūdō is meditation in action. Explosions are part of that action."

operators.name: Iana
operators.abilityDescription:
The Gemini Replicator is a remotely-controlled holographic copy of Iana. It can move and produces sound like she would, but it cannot shoot, melee or use secondary gadgets. It has a time limit, or it can be exited at any time. There is always a cooldown between two uses, which is longer if it’s destroyed.

The Replicator is all about fooling Iana’s opponents and collecting information. During its deployment, she can find her opponents and cause confusion to her heart’s content. If the Gemini is spotted and destroyed, it can help Iana deduce the threat’s location, but it will buy her opponents a few precious seconds to reposition.
operators.quote: "All systems are complementary, if you know how to connect them."

operators.name: IQ
operators.abilityDescription:
- Wrist-mounted
- Mobile phone-sized sensor
operators.quote: "Life is the ultimate Rube Goldberg machine."

operators.name: Jackal
operators.abilityDescription:
Eyenox Model III was created to offer a mobile tracking device able to both identify and trail a person’s footprints in real-time.
Equipped with advanced computer vision, the Eyenox detects invisible details relating to footfall and weight distribution so that you can identify and stalk your target.
operators.quote: "You can't escape me, but that doesn't mean you won't try."

operators.name: Jäger
operators.abilityDescription: Jager can help his team create a defensive stronghold before roaming the map to intercept flanking attackers. He is capable of destroying incoming projectiles due to his unique deployable gadget : the Active Defense System or ADS.
operators.quote: "Birthdays. Proposals. These should be surprises. No one wants a grenade to the face."

operators.name: Kaid
operators.abilityDescription: Kaid’s "Rtila" Electroclaw can electrify reinforced walls and hatches, barbed wire, and deployable shields, making it tougher for the enemy to breach the Kasbah and any facility he’s tasked with protecting. He enters the field with two of these throwable gadgets. Once they’ve attached themselves to a surface, they each electrify metallic objects within a 0.75 meter radius.
operators.quote: "Lead by example and the mountain will move."

operators.name: Kali
operators.abilityDescription:
To talk about the LV Explosive Lance, we need to mention Kali’s CSRX 300. It’s a dangerous weapon that can breach barricades and hatches in a single shot, and create big holes in breakable walls. The LV is its under-barrel, and it can be used at the same time as the CSRX 300’s scopes.

Its role is to destroy gadgets with a light explosion within a set radius. When used on a breakable wall, it will create a hole slightly smaller than what the sniper rifle would do. When shot at a reinforced wall, however, it simply lodges in surface.
operators.quote: "Acceptance of mediocrity is the first step toward failure."

operators.name: Kapkan
operators.abilityDescription: Kapkan is a trap Operator and a deadly addition to a Defending team. Kapkan is equipped with a Entry Denial Device (EDD-MK II). This trap is a packed C4 charge activated when motion is detected. It can be placed on door and window frames -- denying key entry points for attackers.
operators.quote: "There are many different kinds of cunning. Fortunately, survival requires only one."

operators.name: Lesion
operators.abilityDescription:
Gu mines were inspired by the sharp punji sticks used during the Vietnam War. Rubbed with toxic plants or feces, the stakes served to slow down enemy troops by causing severe infections in their camp.
Similarly, Gu mines inject a toxin that injure your opponent and limit their speed.
operators.quote: "Make no excuses for who you are. Only the weak-minded will demand you make yourself smaller."

operators.name: Lion
operators.abilityDescription: Twitch provided him with an aerial drone while he served with GIGN. The EE-ONE-D helps Lion maintain quarantine by detecting movement in an area, giving an overview of hot zones or of the battlefield. His drone can stay airborne indefinitely, but he must choose the right moment to perform his scans.
operators.quote: "Confusing what is right with what is easy can lead down a dangerous path."

operators.name: Maestro
operators.abilityDescription: Maestro uses a remote-controlled turret firing high-energy laser beams. Once affixed to the floor or wall, Maestro can remote-surveil and provide overwatch in a location through the swivel-mounted camera. When the camera device breaks open to fire a laser beam the core is exposed to damage. Otherwise, the turret is unaffected by bullets and melee. Lastly, Evil Eye can see through smoke.
operators.quote: "Did I ever tell you about the time we tree-jumped into a Congo swamp at night? No? Oh, it's a good one."

operators.name: Maverick
operators.abilityDescription: Maverick’s D.I.Y. blowtorch can breach any surface, including reinforced walls and hatches. It requires a steady hand and knowledge of the environment to create small holes and lines of sight. Maverick must be in close range to use his gadget on the chosen surface. This torch makes almost no sound but it runs out of fuel quickly. Nevertheless, the high precision of this gadget makes it a very creative tool to use hands-on without relying on digital technology.
operators.quote: "The Devil's in the details… that's where you'll find me."

operators.name: Melusi
operators.abilityDescription: The Banshee Sonic Defence is deployable on surfaces, much like Maestro’s Evil Eyes, but they don’t require any manual control. As soon as an opponent walks close enough to it, it will release its scream and slow them. It can be destroyed, but since it’s bulletproof, Attackers will have to dispense some utility or strike it up close.
operators.quote: "Understanding is the only tool that vanquishes ignorance."

operators.name: Mira
operators.abilityDescription:
A specialized laminated glass, which when deployed with oxyacetylene can carve out a one-way mirror on any wall.
If the air pressure is disrupted, however, the glass is ejected and creates a daring opening for both defenders and attackers.
operators.quote: "Think of me as your conscience. I see everything, and I'm just as ruthless."

operators.name: Montagne
operators.abilityDescription:
- Collapses into half its size, providing increased mobility to its wielder
- Composite of reinforced alloys and Kevlar
- Provides protection against small-arms fire and close combat attacks
operators.quote: "Every conflict is an iteration upon the last. Every scar, a victory."

operators.name: Mozzie
operators.abilityDescription: Mozzie’s launcher, Pests, are tiny 4-legged bots that can be used to target a single drone, or deployed into an area to prevent access by a drone. When launched, the Pest latches onto the nearest enemy drone and obscures its camera. It then initiates an override sequence to hack the drone and give control to Mozzie. Counter-intelligence is enabled with no risk of a counter hack. Single-use only, Pests self-destruct by dissolving into thin air once their target is in Mozzie’s control.
operators.quote: "C'mon, I'm not here to fuck spiders."

operators.name: Mute
operators.abilityDescription:
- Collapsible antennas
- Device can be planted on floors
- Digital display
- Activation levers
operators.quote: "People think my codename is because I don't like to talk. Maybe I just don't like you."

operators.name: NØKK
operators.abilityDescription: The HEL is a glove attachment, which, when activated, reduces her ambient noise output and hides her image from the opponents’ observation tools. Drones, Bulletproof Cameras, Evil Eyes and more will thus be unable to register Nøkk’s presence as she roams through the map, unseen. Her footsteps will be silenced as she stalks opposing operators, unheard. Roaming will be more risky than ever for Defenders, as Nøkk could be hiding behind every corner or worse, sneaking up right behind them.
operators.quote: "The only thing I feel when I pull the trigger is recoil."

operators.name: Nomad
operators.abilityDescription: Nomad’s custom rifle attachment allows her to launch Airjab repulsion grenades. They can stick to a surface and will detonate when an enemy is within range. Nomad enters the field with three Airjab grenades. These pushback devices are non-lethal but they disorient those affected.
operators.quote: "Deep down in my veins, I knew I had to travel. Now that I have, I'm certain I haven't travelled enough."

operators.name: Oryx
operators.abilityDescription:
The Remah Dash speed allows him to roam efficiently and cover short distances with unprecedented swiftness. It can also be used to knock down opponents and dash through breakable walls, creating a wide opening. Be careful of the cost, though, as he loses health every time the Remah Dash is used for breaching.

Additionally, Oryx has the unique ability to interact with broken hatches. He can climb straight through for a quick rotation, or he can hang on the edge to peek or wait for the perfect moment to go up. As long as he’s hanging, he can also opt to drop down if the climb seems too dangerous.
operators.quote: "Sometimes, the only way out is through."

operators.name: Osa
operators.abilityDescription: The transparent and bulletproof Talon-8 Shield can be carried by Osa or deployed on floors or window frames, giving her a protective line of sight while she formulates an attack strategy.
operators.quote: "The best ideas come to me when I exclude rules and guidelines from the equation."

operators.name: Pulse
operators.abilityDescription: Pulse is a roamer and intel Operator for a defending team. Thanks to his HB-5 Cardiac Sensor, Pulse can track attackers through surfaces, gathering valuable intel on their position.
operators.quote: "The heart is just a motor. Like any machine, it can be fine-tuned."

operators.name: Ram
operators.abilityDescription: Very little can stand in the way of the new BU-GI Auto Breacher. This deployable mini-tank destroys all breakable surfaces and devices in its way along a set path, leaving a trail of destruction in its wake.
operators.quote: "I may not have family, but I have Redhammer."

operators.name: Rauora
operators.abilityDescription: Seize control over the map with Rauora’s D.O.M. Panel Launcher. Deploy bulletproof panels from a distance and strategically control the flow of combat. With a quick trigger at the top of the door, open or close the panel to create tactical opportunities.
operators.quote: "Either you follow me out, or I carry you out. It's your choice."

operators.name: Rook
operators.abilityDescription:
Rook is an anchor and buff Operator, capable of providing a boost to the Defenders, giving them a valuable advantage in a firefight.

Rook is capable of protecting himself and his team mates through his unique ability: R1N ""RHINO"" Armor.
operators.quote: "If you're going to get shot, you may as well do it right."

operators.name: Sens
operators.abilityDescription: R.O.U. Projector System rolls after it's thrown by Sens and drops small projectors to create a screen along its path. Although physical objects can still pass through the screen, it's highly flexible—cutting off multiple lines of sight at once.
operators.quote: "Brute force only gets you so far. Victory is determined in the mind of a strategist."

operators.name: Sentry
operators.abilityDescription: Sentry is the Defender Operator with access to all secondary gadgets for Defense Operators. They have access to the Commando 9 and the M870 as primary weapons, and the C75 Auto and Super Shorty as secondary weapons.
operators.quote: "We eat, sleep and dream Rainbow during training. And one day, it'll pay off."

operators.name: Skopós
operators.abilityDescription: With a pair of V10 Pantheon Shells, Skopós enters the battlefield in control of one as an Operator and the other as an Observation Tool protected by a reinforced shield. While she can only operate one at a time and will lose connection to both shells if one is destroyed, she can switch between them at will, making Skopós an effective intel and support Operator.
operators.quote: "Here's my quote: Don't waste my fucking time."

operators.name: Sledge
operators.abilityDescription:
Sledge is a soft breacher and flanker, he excels at creating new lines of fire and entry points, harassing the defenders.
Sledge is capable of breaching non-reinforced surfaces thanks to his tactical breaching hammer: The Caber.
operators.quote: "Coming through!"

operators.name: Smoke
operators.abilityDescription:
- Detonator
- Remote receiver
- Double-sided tape allows vertical or horizontal mounting
operators.quote: "Sure, I care about the environment. Immediately around me, anyway."

operators.name: Solid Snake
operators.abilityDescription: Find nearby enemy threats with Solid Snake's Soliton Radar Mk. III, a handheld device with a minimap that marks any hostiles present. Use the device's precision mode to pinpoint threats, but be wary, as this will alert enemies that they've been detected by Solid Snake. The Radar provides a view of immediate surroundings, making it an excellent tool for recon that allows allies to lay groundwork and take map control quickly. While hunting down enemies, Solid Snake can also scavenge gadgets from fallen Operators to adapt to the ever-changing needs of the battle.
operators.quote: "It's easy to forget what a sin is in the middle of a battlefield."

operators.name: Solis
operators.abilityDescription: The truth comes to light with Solis' SPEC-IO Electro-Sensor, a new gadget detection device for Defense operatives. With the ability to mark and ping opponents' electronic devices, there is nowhere to hide.
operators.quote: "People lie. Data does not."

operators.name: Striker
operators.abilityDescription: Striker is the Attacker Operator with access to all secondary gadgets for Attack Operators. They have access to the M4 and the M249 as primary weapons, and the 5.7 USG and ITA 12S as secondary weapons.
operators.quote: "We earned the right to be here. Now we just have to earn the right to stay"

operators.name: Tachanka
operators.abilityDescription:
Tachanka’s new gadget, the Shumikha Launcher, is perfect for area denial and for covering unfavorable angles. Its heavy incendiary grenades can bounce multiple times, and their fuse timer only starts after the first bounce, giving them a lot of versatility.

Tachanka is equipped with 10 grenades at the beginning of a match and the Launcher can hold up to 7. For maximum effectiveness, use several grenades together to cover a wider area and prevent your opponents from avoiding them. Once launched, you’ll only be able to reload one at a time.
operators.quote: "They told me I'd died. They were wrong. I was reborn."

operators.name: Thatcher
operators.abilityDescription: Thatcher’s new gadget, the E.G.S. Disruptor, allows him to detect enemy electronic devices through obstructions and deactivate them with an EMP blast. Thatcher should be on the front line, inspecting defenses to allow other Attackers to move in. Thatcher's new device allows for a more precise, disruptive, and modernized gameplay, updating his role while keeping his identity intact.
operators.quote: "What you can feel, what you can touch – those are the things that are real. Everything else is just a distraction."

operators.name: Thermite
operators.abilityDescription: Thermite is an important backline support for an attacking team. As one of the only hard-breachers in the game, losing Thermite early in the round will hinder your team significantly. Playing Thermite requires patience, leadership and strong communication with your team.
operators.quote: "You see a wall, I see an opportunity."

operators.name: Thorn
operators.abilityDescription: The Razorbloom Shell sticks to a surface after it's thrown by Thorn. Shortly after detecting a nearby opponent, it automatically propels a set of sharp blades in all directions, delivering lethal damage.
operators.quote: "We eat, sleep and dream Rainbow during training. And one day, it'll pay off."

operators.name: Thunderbird
operators.abilityDescription: When deployed on the ground, the Kóna Station acts as a point of safety for injured and downed Operators. All they have to do is approach the device, and the Kóna Station automatically boosts the Operator's HP or offers a revive.
operators.quote: "Air or ground, you find your balance or end up with a face full of dirt."

operators.name: Tubarão
operators.abilityDescription: Feel the chill of the new Zoto Canister. The Zoto Canister is a throwable device that can slow enemies, freeze devices to pause their deployment and prevent use, and even leave footprints behind if the frozen area is walked on.
operators.quote: "Acceptable casualties? Nah."

operators.name: Twitch
operators.abilityDescription:
Twitch is a disabler and intel Operator. She can utilize these skills as either a remote back-line support or as an aggressive entry fragger.

Twitch is capable of remote disabling through her unique ability: RSD MODEL 1 SHOCK DRONE
operators.quote: "Machine learning and teamwork have one thing in common: Always lead by example."

operators.name: Valkyrie
operators.abilityDescription:
Encased in a tinted silicone ball, coated in micro-suction cups, the quick deploy camera maintains a clear view thanks to the internal gyroscope that dictates the angle of the lens.
The suction cups allow the camera to adhere to any surface, while the gyroscope mounted lens stabilises the camera angle and focus.
The live video feed is available to all operators.
operators.quote: "If you don't constantly feel like you're being watched, then you aren't paying attention."

operators.name: Vigil
operators.abilityDescription:
Chul Kyung’s quiet lethality in the field allows him to rely on his Electronic Rendering Cloak (ERC-7) to remain undetected.
The ERC-7 uses Diminished Reality technology to remove perceivable stimuli from its direct environment. Vigil carries a prototype in his backpack, which scans surrounding electronic devices and wipes his image from any cameras in view.
operators.quote: "Don't worry about me. I was never here."

operators.name: Wamai
operators.abilityDescription:
The Mag-NET System is a thrown, adhesive gadget. It sticks to surfaces and waits. Its function is to attract an opponent’s projectile to its position, and then self-destruct to detonate that projectile.

This way, not only can Wamai make Attackers’ grenades and projectile gadgets useless, he can also use strategic placement to turn those projectiles against them.
operators.quote: "The closer you are to death, the more vibrant life becomes."

operators.name: Warden
operators.abilityDescription:
The Glance serves a function that was almost non-existent on the Defending team. With it active, Warden can see through smoke and turn around what could be a low-intel situation.
Activating his Smart Glasses can also prevent Warden from being blinded by flash effects, or cleanse an existing flash blindness, salvaging an otherwise dangerous few seconds.
However, the Glance’s thermal vision only works as long as Warden stays immobile; otherwise, he is affected by smoke the same as everyone else.
The Glance is a triggered effect, which must be restored through a cooldown after use.
operators.quote: "I'm never unprepared."

operators.name: Ying
operators.abilityDescription:
Inspired by the new breed of stun grenades showcased by the S.A.S., this mercury and magnesium based explosive creates a multitude of blinding flashes.
The Candela device releases a cluster of flash charges that can either be anchored on surfaces or thrown out as a grenade.
operators.quote: "Protecting others is a calling. If you don't feel it, walk away."

operators.name: Zero
operators.abilityDescription:
Intel is crucial to a good attack strategy, and Zero is well aware of that. His Argus Launcher is equipped with very special cameras that can lodge themselves into breakable and reinforced surface to surveil either side. 

Yes, these cameras can cover two angles and effectively allow you to spy on the opposing team. Argus Cameras do have one more quirk though: a single laser shot, perfect for destroying key elements in the Defenders’ setup or drawing attention away from choke points.
operators.quote: "Prepare, execute, vanish."

operators.name: Zofia
operators.abilityDescription:
KS79 LIFELINE makes use of electronically triggered projectile technology that can fire both concussion and impact ammunition.
The concussion ammunition delivers a 170-decibel shockwave that impairs hearing and causes a dizzying effect.
operators.quote: "It isn't about where you end up, it's about how you make it home."

weapons.name: .44 MAG SEMI-AUTO
weapons.description: The .44 Auto Mag Pistol is a semi-automatic pistol designed in the late 1960's by Auto Mag Corporation and is chambered in .44 AMP.

weapons.name: .44 VENDETTA
weapons.description: The Smith and Wesson Model 629 "Stealth Hunter" is a variation of the more commonly known Model 629 Performance Center. It sports a matte black Stainless Steel finish, holds 6 rounds, and is chambered in .44 Magnum. Compared to the standard Model 629, the Stealth Hunter has a heavier barrel in order to mitigate recoil, a rubberized grip, as well as a Weaver dovetail mount built into the top of the barrel itself, which is used to attach scopes or other sights. Unlike the namesake however, it is not able to accept suppressors.

weapons.name: 1911 TACOPS
weapons.description: The 1911 TACOPS is a handgun.

weapons.name: 416-C Carbine
weapons.description: The HK416 is a German Assault rifle developed by Heckler & Koch in 2004. The HK416 shares lower receiver, magazine, receiver extension, grip, trigger assembly and stock with normal AR-15 rifles, like the M16 and M4 carbine, leading to a level of parts commonality, weapon familiarity and relative low cost. The HK416 uses a short-stroke piston design from the G36 that cycles the bolt carrier, instead of the direct gas impingement system used by the AR-15, which prevents carbon build up inside the bolt carrier to avoid weapon failure and increase reliability and lifespan of the weapon. The HK416C is a compact carbine variant of the HK416 assault rifle. It chambers the 5.56x45mm NATO round. It can be compared to the CQB-R/MARK 18 MOD 0 (An extremely short carbine variant of the M4A1 carbine) due to them both fitting the same ultra short carbine role.

The HK417 is a battle rifle designed and manufactured by Heckler & Koch in Germany. It is a gas-operated, selective fire rifle with a rotating bolt. It's chambered for the full-power 7.62×51mm NATO round, instead of the less powerful 5.56×45mm NATO intermediate cartridge. The HK417 is intended for use in roles where the greater penetrative power and range of the 7.62×51mm NATO round are required. It has been adopted for service by a number of armed forces, special forces, and police organizations.

weapons.name: 5.7 USG
weapons.description: The Five-seven, trademarked as the Five-seveN, is a semi-automatic pistol manufactured by FN Herstal that chambers the 5.7x28mm round. The pistol is named for the round it chambers. The trademark capitalization style is intended to emphasize the manufacturer's initials—FN. The Five-seveN was made as a companion weapon to the P90, since they both chamber the same round. The Five-Seven USG, an abbreviation for United States Government, is a variant listed as a sporting firearm in 2004. It has either adustable or fixed iron sights, an attached Picatinny rail, a magazine safety mechanism and a reversible magazine release.

weapons.name: 552 Commando
weapons.description: The SG 552 Commando is a compact carbine variant of the original SIG SG 550. It has a shorter 8.9inch barrel with an open, three-prong flash suppressor and gas tube, ventilated handguards and a redesigned bolt carrier group that was integrated with the piston rod to form a single moving assembly.

weapons.name: 556xi
weapons.description: The SIG SG 556 is a civilian derivative of the SIG SG 550 assault rifle and is the latest generation of the rifle series. The SIG SG 556 is a semi-automatic rifle manufactured by Swiss Arms AG that chambers the 5.56x45mm NATO round. Unlike the 550, the 556 lacks full-auto capability and the overall length is 940 mm (37.0 in). One difference is a new aluminum lower receiver that accepts M16 STANAG magazines and an M4 telescoping buttstock.

weapons.name: 6P41
weapons.description: The PKP Pecheneg (Russian: ПКП Печенег) is a modernized version of the PKM machine gun designed by TsNIITochMash to be more accurate with the use of a non-interchangeable air-cooled barrel while firing the same 7.62×54mmR round of the PKM. Named after a tribe of Turkic nomads who previously inhabited the steppes, as well as Moldavia and Wallachia, the Pecheneg is capable of mounting telescopic sights to further improve its accuracy over range. Unlike the PKM, the weapon's barrel is not detachable but can still use the same box magazines that can hold 100, 200, or even 250 rounds of ammunition.

weapons.name: 9mm C1
weapons.description: The C1 submachine gun is a "Canadianized" version of the Sterling SMG. It was manufactured by Canadian Arsenals Ltd. The C1 SMG was very popular and remained in service until the mid-1980s, when it was withdrawn and placed in war reserve stock.

weapons.name: 9x19VSN
weapons.description: The PP-19 Vityaz (also known as the PP-19-01 "Vityaz-SN") is a 9×19mm Parabellum submachine gun developed in 2004 by Russian small arms manufacturer Izhmash. It is based on the AK-74 and offers a high degree of parts commonality with the AK-74. The gun is directly developed from the PP-19 Bizon.

weapons.name: ACS12
weapons.description: The Auto Assault-12 (AA-12) is a shotgun developed in 1972 by Maxwell Atchisson. The current 2005 version has been developed over 18 years since the patent was sold to Military Police Systems, Inc. The original design was the basis of several later weapons, including the USAS-12.

weapons.name: AK-12
weapons.description: The AK-12 (formerly the AK-200) is the newest derivative of the AK-pattern series of assault rifles. Originally developed by Kalashnikov Concern (formerly IZHMASH) in 2011, the AK-12 was designed for the Russian Army's "Ratnik" infantry combat system trials in the early 2010s. The AK-12 uses the traditional gas operated action of earlier Kalashnikov rifles, but with several redesigned components for improved accuracy under various conditions as well as integrated Picatinny rails for modern weapon attachments.

weapons.name: AK-74M
weapons.description: The AK-74 (Russian: Автомат Калашникова образца 1974 года, lit. Kalashnikov's Automatic Rifle Model 1974) is an assault rifle developed in the early 1970s by Russian designer Mikhail Kalashnikov as the replacement for the earlier AKM (itself a refined version of the AK-47). It uses a smaller 5.45×39mm cartridge, replacing the 7.62×39mm chambering of earlier Kalashnikov-pattern weapons.

weapons.name: ALDA 5.56
weapons.description: The Ameli (abbreviated from Ametralladora Ligera; Spanish for "Light Machine Gun") is a 5.56mm light machine gun designed for the Spanish Army by the nationally owned and operated CETME small arms research institute.

weapons.name: AR-15.50
weapons.description: The AR-15.50 is a semi-automatic home defense rifle.

weapons.name: AR33
weapons.description: The HK33 is a 5.56mm assault rifle developed in the 1960s by West German armament manufacturer Heckler & Koch GmbH (HK), primarily for export. It uses the G3 operating principle and basic design concept. The rifle was produced in four types: the first type, chambered in 7.62×51mm NATO; the second, using the Soviet 7.62×39mm M43 round; the third, chambered in .223 Remington and 5.56×45mm NATO; and the fourth type, chambered for the 9×19mm Parabellum pistol cartridge. Commercially the HK33 was a successful design but it did not sell as well as the G3.

weapons.name: ARX200
weapons.description: The Beretta ARX200 is a battle rifle variant of the modular ARX160 rifle, which chambers 7.62×51mm NATO rounds. Introduced in 2015, it operates through a short-stroke gas piston system with a rotating bolt, capable of fully automatic and semi-automatic fire.

weapons.name: AUG A2
weapons.description: The AUG (German:Armee-Universal-Gewehr), also known as the StG.77, is a bullpup assault rifle manufactured by Steyr Mannlicher that chambers the 5.56x45mm NATO round. The AUG features a progressive trigger that allows it to fire in semi-automatic and fully-automatic by the pressure exerted on the trigger. The AUG in this case, therefore lacks the conventional fire selector seen on other firearms. The AUG also features an integrated 1.5x magnification scope known as the Swarovski Scope, which is detachable in later variants. The AUG A2 variant is similar to the original AUG but carries the ability to remove the telescopic scope attached to the top, to be replaced with a top rail.

weapons.name: AUG A3
weapons.description: The AUG (German:Armee-Universal-Gewehr), also known as the StG.77, is a bullpup assault rifle manufactured by Steyr Mannlicher that chambers the 5.56x45mm NATO round. The AUG features a progressive trigger that allows it to fire in semi-automatic and fully-automatic by the pressure exerted on the trigger. The AUG in this case, therefore lacks the conventional fire selector seen on other firearms. The AUG also features an integrated 1.5x magnification scope known as the Swarovski Scope, which is detachable in later variants. The AUG A3 variant is similar to the AUG A2 but features an external bolt release and a top rail attached automatically.

weapons.name: BOSG.12.2
weapons.description: The BOSG.12.2 is a fictional double-barrel shotgun.

weapons.name: Bailiff 410
weapons.description: The Taurus Judge is a five shot revolver designed and produced by Taurus International, chambered for .410 bore shotshells and the .45 Colt cartridge.

weapons.name: Ballistic Shield
weapons.description: Ballistic Shield is bulletproof.It Shield has a panel of bulletproof glass at eye level for vision. This glass is indestructible, but can be damaged and reduces vision.It is carried in front of the user, protecting the head and upper body. Some body parts are still exposed, notably the feet and the shoulder.

weapons.name: Bearing 9
weapons.description: The Minebea PM-9 (also known as 9mm Machine Pistol in the Japan Self-Defense Forces (JSDF) or as the M9) is a Japanese-made machine pistol manufactured by the Nippon Miniature Bearing Company, otherwise known as Minebea.

weapons.name: C75 Auto
weapons.description: The CZ 75 Automatic is a selective-fire variant of the CZ-75 that was introduced in 1992 for law enforcement and military use. One distinguishing characteristic of earlier models is its longer compensated barrel although later models may have a standard barrel. An extra magazine can be attached to the front to act as a makeshift foregrip.

weapons.name: C7E
weapons.description: The C7 is a Canadian cousin of the M16A2, made by Diemaco (later Colt Canada after Colt acquired the company). For the most part, the C7 functions and looks very similarly to it's American counterpart, except that it trades out the M16's 3 burst-fire mode for full-auto.

weapons.name: C8-SFW
weapons.description: The Colt Model 725 (or the C8[2] carbine) is a carbine variant of the C7 assault rifle. It is a carbine assault rifle manufactured by Colt Canada that chambers the 5.56×45mm NATO round. The C8 is smiliar to the American M4 carbine (The C8 has ambidexterous fire selectors). The C8-SFW (Special Forces Weapon) variant has a special 400 mm (15.7 inch) barrel that differs from the other variants of the rifle.

weapons.name: CAMRS
weapons.description: The L1A1 Self-Loading Rifle, officially Rifle, 7.62mm, L1A1, also known by the Canadian Army designation C1A1 is a a British Commonwealth derivative of the Belgian FN FAL. The main differences of this variant includes a rotating disc rear sight for 600 yards, a two-piece firing pin, and a shorter receiver cover than other Commonwealth variants to allow for refilling the magazine by charging it with stripper clips.

weapons.name: CSRX 300
weapons.description: Straight-pull bolt-action custom built rifle, with integrated mutli-zoom scope. Chambered in .300 Win Mag.

weapons.name: Commando 9
weapons.description: The Colt 9mm SMG is an M16-based submachine gun firing 9mm rounds. Unlike the M16, it uses a simple blowback operation. The magazines themselves are a copy of the Israeli Uzi SMG magazine, modified to fit the Colt and lock the bolt back after the last shot.

weapons.name: D-50
weapons.description: The Desert Eagle is a semi-automatic pistol manufactured by IWI (Israel Weapon Industries) and Magnum Research. The weapon can be chambered for either the .50 AE, .44 Magnum, or .357 Magnum cartridges, with a respective magazine capacity of seven, eight, or nine rounds. The Desert Eagle can be chambered for .357 Magnum or .50 AE in the Rainbow Six universe.

weapons.name: DP27
weapons.description: The Degtyaryov machine gun or DP-27 is a light machine gun designed for the Soviet Red Army in the 1920s and went into service in 1928. Designed to fire the 7.62×54mmR cartridge, it was the standard Soviet light machine gun during World War II and was commonly modified and used on aircraft and tanks. In 1946, it was replaced by the RP-46 which was a metallic-belt fed version adopted in 1946 with a heavier barrel to allow prolonged sustained fire. The RP-46 remained in Soviet service for 15 years before it was replaced by the PK machine gun.

weapons.name: F2
weapons.description: The FAMAS (French: Fusil d'Assaut de la Manufacture d'Armes de Saint-Étienne) is a bullpup assault rifle manufactured by Nexter Systems (formerly GIAT Industries) that chambers the 5.56x45mm NATO round. The weapon has gone through many variants since its introduction, including the original FAMAS F1 variant, and the following G1, G2, and Felin variants. The FAMAS G2 involves a changed magwell to accept 30-round STANAG magazines, as well as the regular 25-round straight F1 magazines. The additions of a larger trigger guard was also added, as well as fibreglass handguards.

weapons.name: F90
weapons.description: The F90, also known as the EF88, is an Australian descendent of the AUG A1 design intended for export, licensed by Steyr to Lithgow Arms. The original F88 rifle is a licensed copy of the Austrian Steyr AUG rifle, and it was produced in Australia at Australian Defense Industries factory in Lithgow. Today this same factory is operated by the Thales Australia, which developed EF88 / F90 rifle as a next weapon for Australian army, as well as for export.

weapons.name: FMG-9
weapons.description: The Magpul FMG-9 (Folding submachine Gun) is a prototype foldable submachine gun developed by Magpul Industries. It is a lightweight weapon built around the Glock 18 and based off the design of older submachine guns like the UC-M21 and ARES FMG, where it is able to fold up into a small box like package. This, coupled with the weapon's small size, allows it to be easily concealable.

weapons.name: FO-12
weapons.description: The Fostech Origin-12 is a semi-automatic magazine-fed combat/tactical shotgun, developed by Fostech Outdoors. It has been heralded as the fastest semi-auto shotgun on the planet. The adjustable gas system allows reliable cycling from low brass shells to high brass magnum shells.

weapons.name: G36C
weapons.description: The G36C is a subcarbine variant of the G36. Unlike the G36K, it has a shorter barrel and has either a four-prong open-type flash hider or a birdcage type flash hider. It is widely used by both the British and U.S. police departments and counter-terrorism units.

weapons.name: G8A1
weapons.description: The HK21 is a general purpose machine gun made by Heckler & Koch in 1961. It, like many of H&K's weapons, is based on the successful G3 assault rifle. The weapon is in use with the armed forces of several Asian, African and Latin American countries. t is chambered in the 7.62x51mm NATO round is fed from a variety of disintegrating belt ammunition. It can be modified to accept the G3's 20-round box magazine, or a 50-round drum magazine designed for the weapon. The G8A1 is a Bundeswehr and Bundespolizei designation of the Heckler & Koch HK11.

weapons.name: GSh-18
weapons.description: The GSh-18 is a semi-automatic pistol manufactured by the KBP Instrument Design Bureau that chambers the 9x19mm Parabellum round. The weapon was designed Tula by Gryazev and Shipunov which is also where the weapon's name is derived from. The number 18 denotes the magazine capacity.

weapons.name: Glaive-12
weapons.description: The Glaive-12 is a slug shotgun for precise destruction and optimizing line-of-sight setups.

weapons.name: Gonne-6
weapons.description: The GONNE-6 shoots explosive projectiles that detonate on impact with surfaces and destroy bulletproof gadgets.

weapons.name: ITA12L
weapons.description: ITA12L is a lightweight pump action 12-gauge shotgun with a 22" barrel. Packs a good punch.

weapons.name: ITA12S
weapons.description: ITA12S is a compact pump action 12-gauge shotgun with close range stopping power. Optimal for CQB.

weapons.name: K1A
weapons.description: The Daewoo Precision Industries K1 is a South Korean carbine assault rifle, the first modern firearm developed by Agency for Defense Development (ADD) and manufactured by Daewoo Precision Industries, and entered service in the Republic of Korea Armed Forces in 1981. Although the K1 uses 5.56x45mm NATO, it is classified as a submachine gun by the South Korean military and the current manufacturer S&T Motiv, because the K1 was intended to replace the M3 submachine gun. Due to the design of its flash suppressor, the K1 exhibited serious problems in service with the ROK armed forces. The original version had excessive recoil, noise, flash, and weak stock due to increase in firepower. These problems caused difficulty in aiming especially during night operation. These shortcomings were later fixed by the development of the K1A which began production in 1982. The K1A featured a new flash suppressor with three holes in the top right quadrant to limit muzzle flip under rapid fire and reduces flash to one-third of that of the early K1. All K1 submachine guns in service were subsequently modified to the K1A standard.

weapons.name: Keratos .357
weapons.description: The Chiappa Rhino is a revolver produced by Chiappa Firearms of Italy. It is chambered for .357 Magnum, 9mm Parabellum, .40 S&W, or 9×21mm cartridges. The Rhino's most distinctive feature is that the barrel is on a low axis compared to other revolvers. The Rhino fires from the lowermost chamber of the cylinder, rather than firing from the topmost chamber.

weapons.name: L85A2
weapons.description: The L85 is a rifle variant of the SA80 small arms family, all of which are selective fire, gas-operated assault rifles. The L85A2 is an improved model that has undergone H&K upgrades.

weapons.name: LFP586
weapons.description: The Model 586, is a six or seven-shot revolver manufactured by Smith and Wesson that chambers the .357 Magnum round. The Model 686 is a near identical variant of the 586. The Model 586 is essentially the same weapon as the Model 686, albeit with a blued steel construction, while the 686 has a stainless steel construction. The 586 typically has a shorter barrel than the 686 due to being directed for use by law enforcement.

weapons.name: LMG-E
weapons.description: The Ares Shrike 5.56 is an air-cooled, dual-feed rifle for semi or full-auto configurations that fires the 5.56×45mm NATO cartridge. The Shrike 5.56 can be supplied as a complete weapon, or as an upper receiver "performance upgrade kit" to existing M16-type service rifles and carbines.

weapons.name: Luison
weapons.description: The Taurus PT92 is a double action/single action, double-stack-magazine fed, short recoil-operated, semi-automatic 9mm pistol manufactured by Taurus. It was originally produced at the former Beretta factory in São Paulo, Brazil as an almost exact copy of the Beretta 92. Despite the many design changes, such as the redesigned slide serrations, thickening of the trigger guard hook and addition of an accessory rail, the Taurus PT92 still retains many of the design elements from the original Beretta 92.

weapons.name: M1014
weapons.description: The Benelli M4 Super 90, or more commonly known as the M1014, (The United States Marine Corps designation of the M4) is a semi-automatic shotgun manufactured by Benelli. The weapon was designed to replace the Remington 870 as the standard shotgun for the United States Military.

weapons.name: M12
weapons.description: The Beretta Model 12 is a 9×19mm Parabellum caliber Submachine gun designed by Beretta. Production began in 1962 and was first purchased by the Italian army that same year. It was first used in combat in 1968 during the Tet Offensive of the Vietnam War, when the Marines guarding the U.S. embassy in Saigon repelled the assault by the Viet Cong. It is also used by various South American and African countries, and made under license in Brazil by Taurus and in Indonesia by PT Pindad. The Model 12 was redesigned as the Model 12S in 1978, using a 32-round box magazine and chambered for the 9×19 mm NATO cartridge.

weapons.name: M249
weapons.description: The M249 Light Machine Gun, formerly designated as the M249 Squad Automatic Weapon, is the US-produced version of the Belgian-made FN Minimi. The M249 is a light machine gun manufactured by FN Herstal that chambers the 5.56x45mm NATO round.

weapons.name: M249 SAW
weapons.description: The M249 Light Machine Gun, formerly designated as the M249 Squad Automatic Weapon, is the US-produced version of the Belgian-made FN Minimi. The M249 is a light machine gun manufactured by FN Herstal that chambers the 5.56x45mm NATO round.

weapons.name: M4
weapons.description: The M4 is a compact American carbine developed in the 1990s as a shortened and more maneuverable variant of the M16 rifle. It became standard issue for many units of the United States Armed Forces and has been widely adopted by military and law-enforcement organizations around the world. Chambered in 5.56×45mm NATO, the M4 was designed to provide infantry with a lightweight, versatile weapon suitable for both close-quarters and conventional combat

weapons.name: M45 MEUSOC
weapons.description: The MEU(SOC), officially designated the M45 MEUSOC, is a semi-automatic pistol manufactured by Colt's Manufacturing company that chambers the .45 ACP round. The weapon is based on the original M1911 design.

weapons.name: M590A1
weapons.description: The Mossberg 500 is a series of pump-action shotguns manufactured by O.F. Mossberg & Sons. The Mossberg 500 is the most sold shotgun in the world and is only second to the Remington 870 series of shotguns. Although the Mossberg 500 itself did not appear in the Rainbow Six universe, there are several variants of the weapon that have. These are the Mossberg 500 Cruiser, 500 Tactical, and M590A1.

weapons.name: M762
weapons.description: The FB Beryl is a Polish 5.56mm assault rifle, designed and produced by the Łucznik Arms Factory in the city of Radom. The rifle is to replace the 7.62×39mm AKM and 5.45×39mm FB Tantal used in the Polish Armed Forces. The Beryl M762 is a proposed export variant of the FB Beryl that is chambered for 7.62×39mm cartridges.

weapons.name: M870
weapons.description: The Remington Model 870 is a pump-action shotgun manufactured by Remington Arms. The Model 870 is one of the most, if not the most widely used shotgun in the world. The shotgun to only second this weapon in terms of popularity is the Mossberg 500.

weapons.name: MP5
weapons.description: The MP5 (German: Maschinenpistole 5; English: Machine Pistol Model 5) is a submachine gun derivative of the G3 assault rifle. The MP5 is a submachine gun manufactured by Heckler and Koch that chambers the 9x19mm Parabellum round. The MP5 is one of the most widely used submachine guns in the world.

weapons.name: MP5K
weapons.description: The MP5K (German: Kurz; English: Short) is a shortened variant of the MP5 submachine gun. The MP5K is a submachine gun manufactured by Heckler and Koch that chambers the 9x19mm Parabellum round.

weapons.name: MP5SD
weapons.description: The MP5SD (German: Schalldämpfer; English: Sound suppressor) is a variant of the MP5 equipped with an integral suppressor. The MP5SD is a submachine gun manufactured by Heckler and Koch that chambers the 9x19mm Parabellum round.

weapons.name: MP7
weapons.description: The Heckler & Koch MP7 is a PDW (Personal Defense Weapon) manufactured by Heckler and Koch that chambers the 4.6x30mm round. The MP7 was made as a companion weapon to the UCP, since they both chamber the same round.

weapons.name: MPX
weapons.description: The SIG MPX is a gas-operated submachine gun designed and manufactured by SIG Sauer, and is primarily chambered in 9×19mm Parabellum cartridge. It is a gas-operated firearm featuring a closed, rotating bolt. It was designed in 2013 and was released to the general public in 2015.

weapons.name: Mk 14 EBR
weapons.description: The Mark I is a modern variant of the original Browning Hi-Power, also known as the P35, featuring some improvements as well as lacking the provision of the lanyard ring. It is among the best-known models of the P35 developed over the last 50 years.

weapons.name: Mk1 9mm
weapons.description: The Mark I is a modern variant of the original Browning Hi-Power, also known as the P35, featuring some improvements as well as lacking the provision of the lanyard ring. It is among the best-known models of the P35 developed over the last 50 years.

weapons.name: Mk17 CQB
weapons.description: The SCAR-H (Special Operations Forces Combat Assault Rifle) is a battle rifle variant of the FN SCAR that chambers 7.62×51mm NATO rounds. The CQC variation offers a shortened barrel, making it optimal for Close-Quarters Combat, hence the initials.

weapons.name: Mx4 Storm
weapons.description: The Beretta Cx4 Storm is a pistol-calibre semi-automatic carbine aimed at the sporting, personal defense and law enforcement markets. It is available in two models: one that accepts 92/96 magazines, and one that accepts Px4 series magazines, each available in 9×19mm Parabellum, .40 S&W, .45 ACP, and 9×21mm. The Beretta Mx4 Storm is the military version of the Cx4 Storm, which is capable of fully automatic fire. It features a 12-inch barrel, and most commonly seen with a 30-round magazine.oc.

weapons.name: OTs-03
weapons.description: The Dragunov SVU (also known as the OTs-03) is a bullpup designated marksman rifle manufactured by the KBP Instrument Design Bureau that chambers the 7.62x54mmR round. The SVU is essentially an SVD Dragunov built in a bullpup configuration.

weapons.name: P-10C
weapons.description: The firearm's real-life counterpart is the CZ P-10 C, a competitor to the Glock 19 designed for self-defense purposes.

weapons.name: P10 RONI
weapons.description: The CAA Tactical RONI is a frame for Glock and similar pistols that adds a stock and some attachment rails. The in-game model is, contrary to the description, modelled after a CZ P-09 instead of a P-10 in a RONI frame. Like the real-life CZ P-09, the in-game RONI has a magazine capacity of 15+1. Unlike its real-life counterpart, it is fully automatic.

weapons.name: P12
weapons.description: The USP Tactical is a variant of the USP developed in Germany by Heckler & Koch GmbH. Designed to chamber 9mm Parabellum, .40 S&W, and .45 ACP, it incorporates a fully adjustable suppressor height sights, an extended, threaded barrel with O-ring, and a match grade trigger with adjustable trigger stop. A unique characteristic of the USP Tactical is that the barrel is left-hand threaded (counter-clockwise to tighten), which makes the pistol incompatible with suppressors designed for the MK23.

weapons.name: P226 Mk 25
weapons.description: The SIG P226 is a semi-automatic pistol manufactured by SIG Sauer that chambers the 9×19m Parabellum round. Its design is based on the P220, but the P226 has double-stacked magazines rather than the earlier single-stack magazines that the P220 had.

weapons.name: P229
weapons.description: The SIG P229 is a full-sized, service-type pistol made by SIG Sauer. Introduced in 1992, it is a variant of the P228 which itself is a variant of the P226. Developed specifically for the US market, the P229 features a heavier slide to tolerate more powerful rounds the P228 is incapable of. The P229 differs from the P226 in several respects, and was originally introduced to supplement and then replace the P228 by adding the .357 SIG and .40 S&W as available chamberings.

weapons.name: P9
weapons.description: The FN FNP pistol is a series of semi-automatic pistols manufactured by FN Herstal USA, a division of Fabrique Nationale de Herstal. The FNP-9 (or P9) is a variation of FNP chambered for the 9x19mm Parabellum.

weapons.name: P90
weapons.description: The P90 is a compact bullpup PDW (Personal Defense Weapon) designed in the 1990s and manufactured by FN Herstal that chambers the 5.7x28mm round. The P90 was made as the companion weapon to the Five-seveN, since they both chamber the same round. The P90 features an integrated reflex sight and a unique magazine that holds 50 rounds, loads from the top and ejects the casings out of the bottom of the weapon's stock.

weapons.name: PARA-308
weapons.description: The ParaFAL is a 7.62×51mm NATO battle rifle which is a lighter-weight modification of the 30-year-old Brazilian-licensed and built FN FAL. Existing FALs can be converted to the more modern ParaFAL specification by the Brazilian company IMBEL with a low-cost kit of parts. Amongst the changes is a shorter barrel, and replacement of aluminum by high-impact polymer parts.

weapons.name: PCX-33
weapons.description: Being a heavily modified variant of the G3 rifle, the PCX-33 features many parts from multiple different weapons, including: The handguard from the SIG MCX assault rifle; A longer version of the carry-handle from the H&K G36 assault rifle; A custom pistol grip with a guard based off of the IWI TAR-21 assault rifle; The buttstock from the Cadex Defense CDX-SS SEVEN S.T.A.R.S. Series sniper rifles.

weapons.name: PDW9
weapons.description: The UDP9 is a 9mm personal defence weapon developed by Angstadt Arms.

weapons.name: PMM
weapons.description: The PMM, an acronym for Pistolet Makarova Modernizirovannyy (Cyrillic: Пистолет Макарова Модернизированный, English: Modernized Makarov Pistol) is a redesign of the original PM. This was done to increase the cartridge load which resulted in an increase of muzzle velocity and generation of 25% more gas pressure. The Makarov PMM has other minor modifications such as an improved hand grip as well as threaded grooves in the chamber.

weapons.name: PMR90A2
weapons.description: PMR90A2i a high-precision marksman rifle adapted for military specifications.

weapons.name: POF9
weapons.description: The Patriot Ordnance Factory PSG (PSG stands for Patriot Sub Gun) is a 9mm AR-15-type semi-auto pistol/select-fire submachine gun manufactured by Patriot Ordnance Factory, or POF for short.

weapons.name: PRB92
weapons.description: The Taurus PT92 is a double action/single action, double-stack-magazine fed, short recoil-operated, semi-automatic 9mm pistol manufactured by Taurus. It was originally produced at the former Beretta factory in São Paulo, Brazil as an almost exact copy of the Beretta 92. Despite the many design changes, such as the redesigned slide serrations, thickening of the trigger guard hook and addition of an accessory rail, the Taurus PT92 still retains many of the design elements from the original Beretta 92.

weapons.name: Q-929
weapons.description: The QSZ-92 (Chinese: 92式手枪; Pinyin: Jiǔ Èr Shí Shoǔqiàng; Literally: "Type 92 Handgun") is a semi-automatic pistol designed by Norinco. It is a recoil-operated, locked-breech and has a rotating barrel locking system.

weapons.name: R4-C
weapons.description: The Remington R4 is an M4 carbine designed and manufactured by Remington Arms. It is one of many AR-15 type rifles which uses a gas piston operating system in an attempt to improve the reliability of the weapon.

weapons.name: RG15
weapons.description: The VIS 100, formerly called the PR-15 Ragun, is a semi-automatic pistol developed and manufactured by FB "Łucznik" Radom for military and law enforcement personnel.

weapons.name: Reaper MK2
weapons.description: The Glock 18 is a select-fire variant of the Glock 17 pistol. The Glock 18 is a machine pistol manufactured by Glock Ges.m.b.H. that chambers the 9x19mm Parabellum round.

weapons.name: SASG-12
weapons.description: The Saiga-12 is a 12-gauge shotgun available in a wide range of configurations, patterned after the Kalashnikov series of rifles and named for the saiga antelope. Like the Kalashnikov rifle variants, it is a rotating bolt, gas-operated gun that feeds from a box magazine. All Saiga-12 configurations are recognizable as Kalashnikov-pattern guns by the large lever-safety on the right side of the receiver, the optic mounting rail on the left side of the receiver and the large top-mounted dust cover held in place by the rear of the recoil spring assembly.

weapons.name: SC3000K
weapons.description: The FN F2000 is a Belgian 5.56x45mm NATO bullpup assault rifle developed by FN Herstal, featuring modular parts. It fires from a closed bolt system and was designed with the same safety and trigger mechanisms as the earlier P90 submachine gun. The F2000 has many custom designed modular parts, including its own grenade launcher system (known as the FN EGLM) that it shares with the later SCAR series, and a custom fixed 1.6x magnification telescopic sight that can be used in low light conditions.

weapons.name: SDP 9mm
weapons.description: The Sphinx SDP Compact Duty is part of the Sphinx SPD series of semi-automatic pistols produced by Sphinx Systems, a Swiss gun-manufacturing company known for their high-quality handguns. The Sphinx models are some of many variants of the CZ-75 pistols made by the Czech-based ČZUB firearms manufacturing company.

weapons.name: SG-CQB
weapons.description: The Fabarm SDASS Tactical is a pump-action shotgun manufactured by FABARM (Fabbrica Bresciana Armi S.p.A.). It is designed for police and/or security uses and features a folding front sight, built-in Picatinny rails on the top of the receiver, and a lengthened forearm to provide better control over the gun. SDASS shotguns are manufactured in a variety of differing styles.

weapons.name: SIX12
weapons.description: SIX12 SDis a compact 12-gauge bullpup double action revolver shotgun. Good for CQC and fast reload.

weapons.name: SIX12 SD
weapons.description: SIX12 SDis a compact 12-gauge bullpup double action revolver shotgun. Good for CQC and fast reload. Integrated supressor.

weapons.name: SMG-11
weapons.description: The MAC-11 (Military Armament Corporation Model 11) is a subcompact variant of the MAC-10 machine pistol. The MAC-11 is a machine pistol manufactured by the Military Armament Corporation that chambers the .380 ACP round.

weapons.name: SMG-12
weapons.description: The MasterPiece Arms MPA935SST is a modified version of the MAC-11. It features an 8-inch fixed barrel pistol and is offered in 9mm with 30-round magazines standard. It also features a threaded barrel with ½ x28tpi threads making it suppressor ready. It also features adjustable front and rear sights, a side-cocker, scope mount, short handguard and angled foregrip and features all the accuracy, low recoil and performance expected from other weapons in Masterpiece Arms Defender series.

weapons.name: SPAS-12
weapons.description: The SPAS-12 is a dual-mode (both pump-action and semi-automatic) shotgun manufactured by Luigi Franchi SpA. It originally stood for Special Purpose Automatic Shotgun, but was the S was later changed to stand for Sporting Purpose Automatic Shotgun instead. The SPAS-12 contains a unique feature, being able to be in either pump-action or semi-automatic firing modes. The SPAS-12 also contains a foldable buttstock, equipped with a stock-end hook to assist with firing one-handed.

weapons.name: SPAS-15
weapons.description: The SPAS-15 is a successor to the SPAS-12 shotgun. The SPAS-15 is a dual-mode (both pump-action and semi-automatic) shotgun manufactured by Luigi Franchi SpA. The gun was made as an improvement to the SPAS-12 in just about every way, including a removable magazine, carry handle and weight reduction through liberal usage of polymers to address design issues of its predecessor.

weapons.name: SPSMG9
weapons.description: The MP9 (Machine Pistol 9mm) is a derivative of the TMP machine pistol. The MP9 is a machine pistol manufactured by Brügger & Thomet that chambers the 9×19mm Parabellum round.

weapons.name: SR-25
weapons.description: The SR-25 (Stoner Rifle-25) is a semi-automatic sniper rifle manufactured by Knight's Armament Company that chambers the 7.62x51mm NATO round. It was designed by Eugene Stoner, who also designed the AR-10 rifle and its successor, the AR-15.

weapons.name: Scorpion EVO 3 A1
weapons.description: Scorpion EVO 3 A1 is a select-fire submachine gun manufactured by Česká zbrojovka Uherský Brod. The A1 variant features a select fire switch, giving the operator the choice of "safe", semi-automatic, three-round burst, or fully automatic fire.

weapons.name: Spear .308
weapons.description: The Saritch (Russian: Сарыч) is a concept bullpup rifle. It was designed by design school student Andrei Ovsyannikov (as a part of his graduation design project) as a modular civilian carbine, with semi-automatic fire and 10-round magazines. Military versions were also conceived with 30 round magazines and automatic fire. However, nothing really came out of the idea and no functional models exist, as the only model of the concept was a mock-up.

weapons.name: Super 90
weapons.description: The Super 90 is a series of pump-action and semi-automatic shotguns produced by Benelli Arms SpA.

weapons.name: Super Shorty
weapons.description: The Remington M870 MCS Breacher is a pump-action shotgun manufactured by Remington Arms. A variant of the M870, it is part of a the newer modular variants of the M870 which can be quickly modified with different barrels, magazine tubes, and stocks for different purposes, such as urban combat and door breaching. The Breacher model is the smallest MCS variant of the Model 870 with its 10 inch barrel and no stock. The Breacher is also commonly fitted to carbines such as the M4 to form the Masterkey system.

weapons.name: SuperNova
weapons.description: The Benelli SuperNova is a pump-action shotgun manufactured by Benelli Armi SpA. It's based on the Benelli Nova, which was renowned for its Technopolymer one piece frame. The weapon is generally used for hunting, self-defense and law enforcement.

weapons.name: T-5 SMG
weapons.description: The JS 9 mm (Chinese: JS 9 mm冲锋枪; Pinyin: JS 9 mm Chōngfēng Qiāng; Literally: "JS 9 mm Submachine Gun") is a commercial export version of the QCW-05 (with the exception of different chambering.) It is a submachine gun developed by the Jianshe Industries (Group) Corporation of Chongqing. The JS 9 mm is capable of using any 9×19mm round, including the popular 9×19mm Parabellum round but has specifically been chambered for the indigenous, armour-piercing 9×19mm DAP92-9 round.

weapons.name: T-95 LSW
weapons.description: The QBB-95 is a light support weapon that is based on the QBZ-95. The longer, heavier barrel and 80-round drum magazine of the QBB-95 allows for sustained firing, although it's still compatible with the 30-round box magazines of the assault rifle it was based on.

weapons.name: TACIT .45
weapons.description: The TACIT .45 is a compact, semi-automatic pistol customized for covert operations. This weapon is unique to Snake.

weapons.name: TCSG12
weapons.description: The Akdal MKA 1919 is a Turkish gas-operated semi-automatic magazine-fed shotgun resembling the M16 that mimics its layout and controls. Manufactured by Akdal Arms in 2007, it is used by the Turkish Land Forces.

weapons.name: Type-89
weapons.description: The Type 89 is an assault rifle manufactured by Howa that chambers the 5.56x45mm NATO round. The weapon is known as Buddy by the JGSDF (Japan Ground Self-Defense Service). The Type 89-F is a variant of the Type 89 with a folding stock rather than the fixed stock, which is what the original Type 89 had.

weapons.name: UMP45
weapons.description: The UMP (German: Universale Maschinenpistole; English: Universal Machine Pistol) is a submachine gun that was designed by Heckler and Koch as a lighter and cheaper successor to the MP5.

weapons.name: USP40
weapons.description: The USP (German: Universelle Selbstladepistole; English: Universal Self-loading Pistol) is a family of semi-automatic pistols manufactured by Heckler & Koch since 1993 for use primarily in commercial and law enforcement markets. The USP eventually led to the design of the MK.23 that is currently in use by USSOCOM.

weapons.name: UZK50Gi
weapons.description: The Uzi, named after its inventor Uziel Gal, is a submachine gun manufactured by IWI (Israel Weapon Industries) that chambers the 9x19mm Parabellum round. The Uzi is currently the most widely sold submachine gun in the world, and has been produced in many variants, including the Mini-Uzi and the Micro-Uzi.

weapons.name: V308
weapons.description: The V308 is a fictional Battle Rifle based on the KRISS Vector submachine gun. The weapon uses the chassis and feed system of the Vector and is chambered in the 7.62x51 NATO cartridge. It utilizes the recoil mitigation system in the Vector to reduce vertical muzzle climb.

weapons.name: Vector .45 ACP
weapons.description: The KRISS Vector is a series of weapons based upon the parent submachine gun design developed by the American company KRISS USA. They use an unconventional delayed blowback system combined with in-line design to reduce perceived recoil and muzzle climb. The Vector SMG is a selective-fire submachine gun developed by KRISS USA, formerly Transformational Defense Industries (TDI). It's the only weapon to feature full-automatic fire mode in the KRISS Vector series. The Vector is popular for its unique delayed blowback operation which allows using weapon's high rate of fire with the minimum recoil.

weapons.name: XK23
weapons.description: Experimental bullpup rifle chambered in 6.8 SPC with superior maneuverability. Best for mid-range combat.

gadgets.name: Barbed Wire
gadgets.description: The main feature of Barbed Wire is to slow the movement of any Attackers and Drones that enter it. On top of that, when enemies do enter Barbed Wire, they create rustling sounds which Defenders can take advantage of.

gadgets.name: Breach Charge
gadgets.description: A breach charge is an explosive device used by military, police, or emergency services to force open closed and/or locked doors. A wide range of breaching methods may be used in any given situation, but explosive breaching can be the fastest method, though it is also the most dangerous, to both the breachers and the room occupants. Depending on the situation, explosive breaching is potentially slower than a ballistic breach due to the large standoff required when using explosives, if there is no cover available. Breaching can be performed with a specially formed breaching charge placed in contact with the door, or with various standoff breaching devices.

gadgets.name: Bulletproof camera
gadgets.description: A bulletproof camera that defenders can deploy on floors and walls to maintain surveiliance on areas. It can see through thick smoke and it can survive direct shots to its front plate.

gadgets.name: Claymore
gadgets.description: The M18 Claymore is an anti-personnel mine that consists of a curved rectangular plastic shell with a layer of ¾ of a pound of composition C3 explosive. It has a fragmentation face of rectangular steel fragments designed to blow out in a fan-shaped pattern. Because of the explosive charge, there is a small area of lethality directly behind the mine, as well as the area of devastation in front of the blast.

gadgets.name: Deployable Shield
gadgets.description: The Deployable Shield is a collapsible waist-high bulletproof metal shield that can be placed by Defenders to create additional cover. Tiny bulletproof window slits are built into the Deployable Shield, allowing both sides to see through the Shield.

gadgets.name: Frag Grenade
gadgets.description: A hand grenade is a small, light-weight, timed explosive device. Grenades can inflict severe damage against infantry and other soft targets. Most hand grenades used are fragmentation grenades, often abbreviated to "frags", which litter an area with shrapnel, inflicting severe damage on infantry and lightly armored targets. The M67 grenade is a development of the M33 grenade, itself an improvement of the M26 series of grenades, that was designed in the late 1950s and adopted in 1968 for use by the US Army. It is also known as a "baseball" grenade due to its shape.

gadgets.name: HARD BREACH CHARGE
gadgets.description: A hard breach charge is an explosive device used by military, police, or emergency services to force open closed and/or locked doors. A wide range of breaching methods may be used in any given situation, but explosive breaching can be the fastest method, though it is also the most dangerous, to both the breachers and the room occupants. Depending on the situation, explosive breaching is potentially slower than a ballistic breach due to the large standoff required when using explosives, if there is no cover available. Breaching can be performed with a specially formed breaching charge placed in contact with the door, or with various standoff breaching devices.

gadgets.name: Impact EMP Grenade
gadgets.description: Impact EMP grenade disables Defender gadgets caught within it's 5.2 meter radius. The EMP passes through surfaces, allowing players to disable devices on the other side of a wall.

gadgets.name: Impact Grenade
gadgets.description: The Impact Grenade is an explosive grenade that, as its name implies, detonates on impact and deals light damage, designed to efficiently create rotation routes and lines of sight. Once thrown, Impact Grenades can travel up to 20 meters before hitting a surface or detonating mid-air.

gadgets.name: Nitro Cell
gadgets.description: Composition 4, often shortened to C4, is a plastic explosive composed of RDX, plastic binder, plasticizer, and a marker chemical to identify its source. It is 1.34 times as explosive as TNT and has been used since the 1960s when it was developed. C4 is often used in breaching obstacles or demolition of large structures.

gadgets.name: Observation Blocker
gadgets.description: Once deployed, the Observation Blocker will project a digital barrier screen that will block the line of sight of observation tools like the Drone or CCTV. This prevents players from seeing anything on the other side of the screen unless the gadget is destroyed or the drone moves past it. The gadget's digital barrier is only visible from observation tools and cannot be seen by Operators. This is useful for concealing any traps or fortifications in an area as well as Defender locations.

gadgets.name: PROXIMITY ALARM
gadgets.description: Once thrown the Proximity Alarm will indicate its effective radius and must fill the radius in order to be activated. The gadget will emit an alarm once an enemy enters its 3 meter radius, alerting Defenders to their general location. The Proximity Alarm activates nearly as soon as the effective radius is reached, taking a short delay to activate. The alarm the device makes is a beeping noise that can be heard by both Attackers and Defenders. A HUD icon will appear on Attackers who enter the Proximity Alarm's radius. The Proximity Alarm's beeping can be heard a great distance away, even through surfaces.

gadgets.name: Smoke Grenade
gadgets.description: The M18 smoke grenade is the standard issue smoke grenade of the United States Army since its development in 1942, for use in World War II and the Vietnam Wars. The M18 smoke grenade is produced in three colors - red, green and yellow, and was formerly produced in violet until the 1990s.

gadgets.name: Stun Grenade
gadgets.description: A stun grenade (also known as a flashbang) is a small explosive device that, when thrown, emits a large flash of light and a very loud bang that temporarily blinds and deafens those affected in the vicinity. They are commonly used by military and special police forces in house clearing and surgical raids.
